'''J. Michael Tatum''' is an American voice actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}} and {{aniseries|HZ}}.

==Biography==
Tatum was born as John Michael Tatum on May 15, 1976, in McKinney, Texas. He had a stutter as a child, which prompted his speech coach to get him involved in theatre. His performances allowed him to overcome his stutter, inspiring him to become an actor. He became a voice actor with {{wp|Funimation}} after being discovered by one of the studio's ADR directors. Tatum became involved with the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|DP}}, with his major roles being {{si|Tobias}} and [[Damon]]. He also joined {{aniseries|HZ}} with the role of [[Brassius]]. He currently co-hosts a podcast called ''That Anime Show''.
